title: Bug: branch deselection on delete
body:
After Publish or Discard in the editor, the dashboard's active_branch state is not refreshed in the same render cycle. User sees errors and must manually click 'View source'.

Fix:
- Investigate on_confirm_publish and on_discard callbacks in components/dashboard.rs (approx lines 645–721)
- If branch selector panel is open during deletion, close it and reset panel state
- Ensure force_refresh counter is incremented after set_active_branch so refetch uses source branch
- Verify: deleting a branch returns to source-branch content with no errors
